prompt: Upgrade the shared framework dependency across this monorepo without breaking downstream packages. Stage the work so failures can be isolated and reverted.

ordinaryCodex.adaptiveInterior: Codex decides how to inspect the dependency graph, edit packages, and run checks.
ordinaryCodex.observableAfterRun: Thread items, tool activity, changes, and the final response.

phases.name: Map affected packages
phases.goal: Inspect manifests, lockfiles, package relationships, compatibility constraints, and the available test matrix before editing.

phases.name: Propose upgrade batches
phases.goal: Group the affected packages into reversible batches and identify public API or build-system risks.

phases.name: Approve upgrade sequence
phases.question: Continue with the proposed batch order, compatibility strategy, and rollback points?

phases.name: Upgrade in batches
phases.goal: Apply the approved dependency and source changes, checking each batch before continuing.

phases.name: Verify the package matrix
phases.criteria: Lockfiles are consistent, affected package builds and focused tests pass, and public compatibility checks show no unexplained regression.

limits: This is an illustrative design and has not been run across a real monorepo.
A passing focused matrix does not prove every downstream consumer is compatible.
Codex still owns the adaptive file and tool loop inside each Work phase.
